component.name: ClipVault
component.summary: A lightweight, privacy-aware clipboard manager for Linux

description.p: ClipVault is a lightweight, privacy-conscious clipboard manager for Linux desktop environments, supporting both Wayland and X11 sessions.

ul.li: Three-tier clipboard monitoring (instant Qt signals, off-thread background worker, and polling)
Automatic sensitive content detection and filtering for password managers such as KeePassXC, Bitwarden, 1Password, and KWallet
Virtualized list view for constant memory usage regardless of history size
Instant search filtering, pinned favorites, and single-click copy restoration
Single-instance architecture with desktop shortcut toggle support
Reliable SQLite persistent storage powered by Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode
